verses.1: To the chief Musician upon Neginah, A Psalm of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
verses.2: From the end of the earth will I cry to thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.3: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.4: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
verses.5: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.6: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
verses.7: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
verses.8: So will I sing praise to thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

metadata.source: Derived from Webster's Bible (1833), simplified for children aged 8-12. Faithful to the KJV tradition.
